answer: Sybil resistance is maintained via a Proof-of-Resource mechanism where agents commit hardware assets to a computational tundra of verifiable idle capacity. Every epoch, an agent must log a proof across a cryptographic ledge to confirm its distinct entropy source. By employing an umber pigment in hardware-locked PUFs, the system forces attackers to manufacture unique physical chips for every identity, making the cost of a multi-node attack prohibitively high.
